signals.responsibilityReview: Owns a single controlled Tiptap editor and its inert body preview. Editor schema, formatting controls, safe paste, selection preservation and externally supplied draft synchronization are one local presentation responsibility. Attach invokes the existing picker through a callback; no upload, provider, state persistence or authority implementation is introduced. External rewrite/guarded-Undo replacements start a new editor history, while local typing and formatting retain native Undo. This prevents the native keyboard history from bypassing guarded Meri Undo lifetime checks.
signals.reviewDisposition: Proposed for root independent exact review; no shared registry changed

signals.responsibilityReview: Owns one in-flight rewrite, verified result and one local Undo under the same draft/source and captured-authority lifetime. Atomic MailBody replaces the old string snapshot so formatting-only edits revoke pending/previous rewrites and Undo restores text plus HTML together. Existing transport, cancellation, source revision and identity checks remain unchanged.
signals.reviewDisposition: Proposed for root independent exact review; no shared registry changed
